editor.label: Source Text (Markdown)
editor.empty: Start typing in the editor to see your book take shape here.

guide.title: Text Format
guide.intro: Write your book in simplified Markdown. These are the elements Warraq understands:
guide.subTitle: Numbered sub-heading (auto-numbered inside the chapter)
guide.termBody: Any paragraph that begins with a word or phrase followed by a colon ":" has the part before the colon highlighted automatically — or use **Term:** manually.
guide.paraBody: Any plain line with no symbol in front of it is treated as a normal paragraph.

jsonImport.title: Import JSON
jsonImport.newBookDesc: Paste JSON here in the full book format (title, subtitle, chapters) — this will replace the entire editor content.
jsonImport.addChapterDesc: Paste JSON here for one chapter or an array of chapters — it will be added to the end of the current book without deleting anything.
jsonImport.parseError: Couldn't read the JSON — check the syntax.

promptBuilder.title: Create via AI
promptBuilder.intro: Copy this prompt and paste it into any AI chat tool (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude...) along with your raw book text at the end. Then paste the resulting JSON into the "Import JSON" window.
